name: suede-ab-testing
description: Suede AI experimentation discipline: hypotheses, sample size and power, test duration, guardrail metrics, significance and readouts, sequential designs, and an ICE-ranked experiment backlog with a reusable playbook. Use when comparing variants, deciding whether a result is reliable, or building an experiment program and cadence. NOT FOR: analytics instrumentation (use suede-analytics), post-click conversion diagnosis (use suede-site-alchemy), writing the variant copy (use suede-copy), or channel
author: JasonColapietro
